_comment: Food (backend/food.py). Rations: carried on an adventure they are the member's provisions, and after it each member's ration is used up with rationLossChance. Preserved: stored, eaten any time from home/camp storage or the carried bags, each unit heals preservedHealPoints lost points in its group; all carried preserved food is used up when an adventure ends. Fresh: eaten the moment its craft is collected (never stored), heals freshHealPoints in its group, each dish once per character per freshMealHours (3 Body + 3 Soul dishes: at most 3 Body + 3 Soul points a day). Groups: body / soul (backend.condition).
